blind_target.title: Why people are reluctant to tempt fate
blind_target.evidence_quote: Our attempt to replicate the tempting fate effect reported in Risen and Gilovich (2008) was aimed at testing whether we could find a different magical thinking effect.
blind_target.outcome_quote: We thus think that the successful replication of the tempting fate effect adds credibility to the non-replication of the protection effect.

luna_triage.reason: The Results explicitly say the authors replicated Risen and Gilovich’s tempting-fate effect. The only supplied shipped original, row 2492, is Tykocinski’s insurance/protection study and does not represent Risen and Gilovich’s original finding.
luna_triage.omission_quote: We thus replicated the tempting fate effect reported in Experiment 1 by Risen and Gilovich (2008).
luna_triage.identity_quote: Risen, J. L., & Gilovich, T. (2008). Why people are re- luctant to tempt fate. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 95, 293-307. http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/ 0022-3514.95.2.293

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
